notes.title: Community Report of September 2025!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone, it’s been a while![/p][p]I have good news today![/p][h2]Part-time job[/h2][p]I finally got my part-time contract at my job.[/p][p]I will have one day every week to work on AIdventure! It’s a very good thing as it will allow me to work at a regular pace and to plan stuff![/p][h2]How is the development going to be ?[/h2][p]During the summer, I changed how I organize my work. I’m now following the [url="https://www.scrum.org/learning-series/what-is-scrum/"]Scrum way[/url].[/p][list][*][p]My tasks will be organized in sprint[/p][/*][*][p]A sprint has a specific objective (like bug fix, lorebook feature, etc) and a specific time. Actually, I’m going for 35h of work for each sprint.[/p][/*][*][p]At the end of each sprint, there is a new iteration. Technically, each addition has been tested, but the whole produce has not! This new iteration will be available to those who can’t wait.[/p][/*][*][p]After 4 sprints, a new release is produced (with all the test it implies)[/p][/*][*][p]This release will be pushed in experimental to be tested by you and to get feed back![/p][/*][*][p]The previous experimental release is published as stable (if judged stable enough).[/p][/*][*][p]Repeat the process[/p][/*][/list][p]So, to put time on all of this:[/p][olist][*][p]An unstable small release ~every month (If the product of a sprint is complete. A feature taking two sprints to implement can’t be published half done!)[/p][/*][*][p]A full release in experimental (to get feedback) every 4 sprints (should be 4 months if there is no delay)[/p][/*][*][p]The stable release once I get positive feedback on the experimental release.[/p][/*][/olist][p]If an experimental release gets bad feedback, it will delay the stable release as I will have to spend time on it.[/p][h2]Thanks to my supporters[/h2][p]Thank you for supporting me on [url="https://ko-fi.com/lyaaaaagames" style="button"]Ko-fi![/url][/p][list][*][p]Marco,[/p][/*][*][p]Cynder,[/p][/*][*][p]SirFactorofX[/p][/*][*][p]Zarilain[/p][/*][*][p]patman124[/p][/*][/list][h2]Support me, rate the game and review it![/h2][p][b]Help yourself, help me, because helping me will help me to help you better.[/b][/p][p]If you like my work and want to help me, please, review AIdventure on Steam or rate it on Itch! It’s very important and can help me a lot![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/3e27414862896f98b7ab1dd6c979610d45c330b4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading this report :).[/p][p]See you next time.[/p]

notes.title: AIdventure - Update 2.1.0-Experimental.1
notes.content: [p]Hello, today I’m publishing an update in the experimental branch. This update is only fixing bugs.[/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed being able to upload to Steam Workshop items you are subscribed too[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error in starting menu after downloading a custom AI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed saving settings to all AIs not working for custom AIs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed renaming a lorebook not renaming it in the list of lorebooks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed edit bar disappearing during generation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cancelling previous generation undoing the previous input too[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed new scenarios or lorebook not appearing without a restart of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where a lorebook inside two scenarios can be the same and lead to unwanted modification on both[/p][/*][*][p]Added a description to Distil-Gpt2[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a loop when updating/uploading content to the workshop[/p][/*][/list][h2]How to download it?[/h2][p]To make it quick, I changed how I work. I’m working in what we call sprints (specific amount of time) and I plan to publish a proper release after 4 sprints. But, because some people are impatient :), I make the product of each sprint available. I did 0 test (except automatic tests) so it might not work.[/p][list][*][p]On itch, download the last experimental release (2.1.0.experimental.1)[/p][/*][*][p]On Steam, download the sprint_release beta[/p][/*][/list][h2]What next?[/h2][p]To finish a sprint, it will take me between 1 month to 1.25 month.[/p][p]So you can expect a proper release every 4 month or 5 months.[/p][p]You can find more information in the [url="https://www.lyaaaaagames.com/blog/report_2025_09/"]community report of September[/url][/p]

notes.title: AIdventure - Update 2.1.0-Experimental
notes.content:
Howdy adventurers,


Today, I’m releasing an exciting new version. It will be in open beta for now.


If you want to experiment the [b]newest AIs and a faster generation[/b], you should give this beta a try!


This also introduce the assisted generation, more detail about this below.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*]Implemented the assisted generation[/*]
[*]Added a wiki page about the assisted generation[/*]
[*]Added support for Llama AIs.[/*]
[*]Added open_llama_3b_v2, Llama-2-7b and Llama-2-7b-chat AIs to the game.[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Nvidia driver update[/h2]

If you didn’t update your drivers since a while, you might need to do so. The server will print an error about your nvidia card not being up-to-date.

[h2]For users on Itch[/h2]

Updating the environment on Windows will download ~3GB of data, but the processing might take some minutes. Be patient.

[h2]What is assisted generation?[/h2]

It is using a small AI (the assistant) to accelerate the processing of your prompt.
The assistant will process your inputs and deduce what words come next, then it will ask the big AI to confirm the result.


Here is a video (thanks to Hugging Face for their videos) explaining what happens without the assisted generation


[url=https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/documentation-images/resolve/main/blog/assisted-generation/gif_2_1080p.mov]Video[/url]


Now, let’s have a look at what happens when you use an assistant


[url=//huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/documentation-images/resolve/main/blog/assisted-generation/gif_4_1080p.mov]video[/url]


For more details, you can read their article here: [url=https://huggingface.co/blog/assisted-generation]https://huggingface.co/blog/assisted-generation[/url]

notes.title: AIdventure - Release 2.0.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone,


Today, the 2.0.5 is coming out of the beta.


This patch features bug fixes and quality of life improvements

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New content[/h3]
[list]
[*]Spanish Localization[/*]
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]A new dock with information about the data sent to the server.[/*]
[*]The context used to be x characters long, even if it cuts a sentence in the mi (middle of a word like what just happened). Now it will try to not cut any sentence.[/*]
[*]Some windows now grab focus when they appear[/*]
[*]The story now supports BBcode. The inputs should appear in bold (Result might change depending on your font)[/*]
[*]Added an option to choose the colour of the highlighted text[/*]
[*]The keywords of the lorebook are now highlighted in the input bar! (It has some limitation regarding caps. Moreover, keywords with whitespace aren’t highlighted)[/*]
[*]The AI menu and the server menu now automatically refresh the list of AIs when you delete or download one.[/*]
[*]Added an in game wiki (There isn’t many articles for now)[/*]
[*]Added a popup to help users having the following errors:
[list]
[*]“Cuda out of memory”[/*]
[*]“error loading checkpoint[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Added a button to create an email with all the information needed for the helpdesk.[/*]
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the menu asking you to load the generator, never selecting the default AI.[/*]
[*]Fixed the exclusive fullscreen not working correctly (replaced it by default fullscreen mode)[/*]
[/list]
[h3]Server[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a fallback to change the value of torch_dtype to avoid the “topk_cpu” not implemented for ‘Half’ error.[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Support me[/h2]

If you like my work and want to help me, please, review AIdventure on Steam or rate it on Itch! It’s very important and can help me a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/3e27414862896f98b7ab1dd6c979610d45c330b4.gif[/img]

[h2]What is coming next ?[/h2]

For now, I will keep working on small improvements and bug fixes.


See you.

notes.title: Community report of May 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I’m publishing a dev log for this month with an important info!

[h2]New job[/h2]

I finished my job at the university last month. I should have a new job in the following weeks.
But, this job will be a full-time one. I found out part-time is hard/impossible to find in my country in my domain.
Everyone wants to hire you for endless contracts at full-time (which is good, but not what I needed).


But there is something cool about this job. In 2 years, I will be allowed to turn it into a stable part-time job. Therefore, it will ensure I can both live and work on my company. So that’s a good point.


Of course, it means [b]AIdventure’s development will SLOW DOWN[/b] until that time. Because of it, I will be focusing on small tasks and don’t implement new features, [u]small tasks[/u] like quality of life (QoL), text to speech, bug fixes, auto-translation, that kind of stuff.


So, AIdventure should still get better, but without anything significant change.

[h2]Epic game release and adult content :O (Click bait)[/h2]

I first planned to release AIdventure on Epic the 1st May, but it was impossible because I forgot I had
NSFW AIs downloadable, and Epic doesn’t accept adult games. So it delayed the launch.
But, good point is, I will soon publish a SFW version on Itch as well, in case parents want to show this
game to their kids.

[h2]Experimental version available[/h2]

As I said, I will focus on QoL improvements and bug fixes.

You can see on this graph all my tasks organized by area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/0375f0f60a54f3fc80e88f97cdd34c193e3db811.png[/img]

As you can see, I have much to do!

I’m going to publish it as often as I can in the experimental branch on Steam. Don’t hesitate to try it and give me feed back about the changes!

[h2]Thanks to my supporters[/h2]

Thank you for supporting me on Ko-fi!

[list]
[*]Marco,[/*]
[*]Cynder,[/*]
[*]SirFactorofX[/*]
[*]Zarilain[/*]
[*]patman124[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Support me too[/h2]

You can support me, too, on [url=https://ko-fi.com/X8X3V6LB9]Ko-Fi[/url].


[h2]Or rate the game and review it![/h2]

[b]Help yourself, help me, because helping me will help me to help you better.[/b]


If you like my work and want to help me, please, review AIdventure on Steam or rate it on Itch! It’s very important and can help me a lot!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/3e27414862896f98b7ab1dd6c979610d45c330b4.gif[/img]


Thank you for reading this report :).


See you next time.

notes.title: Community Report of March 2024!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I’m publishing a new community report. It’s been 2 months since the last report (January) because February was very busy.

[h2]New jobs[/h2]

As you probably know (from my announcement about my Ko-fi page). I have to work once again (on something else than AIdventure) to pay the bills.


From February to April, I’m giving lessons at university to teach programming.
It’s cool but takes a good part of my time (as I have to write courses).


After April, I will be looking for full-time jobs (I hope to find some with short duration to not put AIdventure on hold for too long!)


No worries, AIdventure’s development will only be on halt during that time (I plan to not spend all my free time working on AIdventure like I did in 2022-2023). I’m never going to cancel it! The development will resume at the end of my contract (I will have more specific info once I actually find a full-time job).

[h2]The 2.0 rush[/h2]

As you maybe noticed, the release of the 2.0 happened a few days before the Steam Remote Play festival. It was my intention since November to publish the 2.0 by that time and announce the support of the Remote Play Together.


I’m satisfied by this new version, it looks awesome and thanks to the beta testers it was a good release.

[h2]AIdventure coming out on Epic Games[/h2]

AIdventure should be released on Epic Games by the end of the month (if everything goes smoothly). The point of releasing the game on more shops is to increase the visibility, hence, the sales (money…)

[h2]Localization[/h2]

If you follow every update, you also noticed I released the game in French, Russian and Turkish. I always planned to support many languages, and the 2.0 is a good base for exporting the game to more markets. I will support more languages in the following weeks. It costs money, but I think it’s worth.

[h2]The next big update???[/h2]

For now, I had no time to decide what will be the next big update (Maybe the RPG extension). I have been working on legal stuff, localization, the new shop and fixing small problems.


So, I will soon have a look at the possible new updates and create a poll.
My supporters on Ko-fi will be able to vote for the next feature!

[h2]The Ko-fi page[/h2]

You can find all the information about the Ko-fi page on
[url=https://www.lyaaaaagames.com/blog/subscription_announcement/]https://www.lyaaaaagames.com/blog/subscription_announcement/[/url]


This is a way to increase my income and allow (maybe one day) to work full-time on AIdventure without losing money.


[h2]Rate the game and review it![/h2]

If you like my work and want to help me, please, review AIdventure on Steam or rate it on Itch! It’s very important and can help me a lot!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/3e27414862896f98b7ab1dd6c979610d45c330b4.gif[/img]

Thank you for reading this report :).


See you next time.

[h2]Why am I accepting subscriptions?[/h2]

AIdventure is a project I love. At first, it was a simple Python file to experiment text generation.
I was using AIdungeon and was enjoying it. Then, Latitude changed some things and I hated it!
([u]Spying on me was also a very bad habit of them[/u])
Then, I thought

[i]“Alright, if I can’t play AIdungeon as I want, I will make my own!”[/i]

(it’s probably a very bad behaviour, not sure, lol).


At the same time, I lost my job (Covid, you know) and got 4 months of free time ahead of me! So I worked full-time on this nameless prototype. I came up with a name and the 25 December 2021, I rushed the publication.


(No joke!, see this proof)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/c90dad0fb1a83ca62e64073dfff6c5bd82ae7b64.png[/img]


I couldn’t actually believe that much people would find it cool! All your feed-back convinced me it was worth finishing this project!


After this, I worked when I had free time (mostly on my week ends and vacations) on this game.
And since September 2023 until today, I worked full-time on it once again! While It was great to make progress, my bank account didn’t like it! :)


So I’m now going to work (full time / part time) again. This subscription system is a safe solution to get money while working on AIdventure. That’s why I’m starting it!


And of course, if I can get enough, it will mean I can work full-time on AIdventure!

[h2]Subscribe before the discount ends![/h2]

[b]Support me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/lyaaaaagames]https://ko-fi.com/lyaaaaagames[/url][/b]

[h2]Why not using Patreon?[/h2]

[b]Because it takes 12%[/b] (as simple as that).


If you are believing in me enough to give me your support, I believe you would also like me to get most of the money you are spending!
So I prefer using Ko-fi.


Here is a small list of benefits of not using Patreon:

[olist]
[*]100% (tax not counted) of the money you spend is sent to me (quite a good reason, I think)[/*]
[*]You don’t require an account to support (Just an email to support as a guest. You can create an account, though.)[/*]
[/olist]
[h2]Will it be possible to change of package or cancel a subscription?[/h2]

Yes, you will be able to manage your membership at any time! Just know you will lose your lifetime discount if you change after the discount period. To keep it, you will have to email me, so I can manage it.


I will also handle refunds if you ever need. You can [url=https://www.lyaaaaagames.com/policies/membership_refunds/]read the full refunds policy here[/url]

notes.title: AIdventure 2.0.0 is out!
notes.content:
More than 500 commits and 650 files changed! AIdventure 2.0.0 is the biggest update the game had since its creation!


It’s mostly under the hood changes and a new interface. But it’s paving down the way for the next big updates!

[h2]But what is the most anticipated feature of AIdventure 2.0.0?![/h2]

[previewyoutube=cGWQdch_ycM;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy this major update!

[h2]Important instructions[/h2]

If you are upgrading from the 1.5 to the 2.0 you should read this.

[olist]
[*]Verify the AI settings. They will be reset and automatically defined at the first start.[/*]
[*]The AIs are now organized in a new folders tree.[/*]
[/olist]
[list]
[*]models/
[list]
[*]generators/ move your generators here[/*]
[*]customs/ move customs AIs here[/*]
[*]translators/ move translators here[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[olist]
[*]The AIs are now stored in the app data folder. [b]Except gpt2-large[/b] You can keep it in models/generators/LyaaaaaGames/.[/*]
[/olist]
[list]
[*]Windows: %APPDATA%\aidventure\models[/*]
[*]Linux: ~/.local/share/aidventure\models Might vary.[/*]
[/list]

To simplify moving your AIs, you can open the game, go to the AI options, and click on “Open AI folder”, then move your AIs here (the new folders will already be created).

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Upgraded the engine (Godot 3.5 → Godot 4.2)[/*]
[*][b]FULL REWORK[/b] of the interface (See details below).[/*]
[*]Sliders are now used for many options.[/*]
[*]Settings for AIs are now saved individually (You can have different settings for each AI).[/*]
[*]Added in the options a default AI (will be selected by default)[/*]
[*]Buttons now do a sound.[/*]
[*]Added a [u]ding[/u] sound when the generation is over.[/*]
[*]Settings are now semi-automatically defined depending on your hardware[/*]
[*]Added settings preset to simplify modification of the Generators’ settings.[/*]
[*]Merging lore books together is now possible.[/*]
[*]You can now download AIs in the background while playing.[/*]
[*]You can now queue AIs to download.[/*]
[*]PRESSING [b]ENTER[/b] IN THE INPUT BAR NOW GENERATES (YES, PEOPLE, I HEARD YOU. One day, I will allow you to change shortcuts!).[/*]
[*]AIs are now directly downloaded in the right folder (They are no longer moved after the download).[/*]
[*]Added School-Setting tag (cuz why not. Suggest new tags if you want).[/*]
[*]Changing the point of view in the settings doesn’t require restarting the game any more.[/*]
[*]Fixed two English mistakes in some default scenarios[/*]
[/list]
[h2]New content[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]A small sanctuary[/b], scenario by Nyghtfall.[/*]
[*]A new menu to interact with the Steam Workshop[/*]
[*]Lore books from the Steam Workshop are now usable in the game![/*]
[*]A notification system.[/*]
[*]Can now download custom AI once again[/*]
[*]Downloaded custom AIs are now automatically formatted to be optimized for the game.[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Full rework of the UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]The whole theme (overall style of the game) has been changed. Theme by [url=https://azagaya.itch.io/]Azagaya[/url][/*]
[*]Changed the main menu.[/*]
[*]The input bar now displays a progress bar (based on the max generation time allowed).[/*]
[*]You can now edit the story by double-clicking on it.[/*]
[*]The story interface has now two docks on each side (one for the server, one for the character).[/*]
[*]New editors to edit the scenarios and lore books.[/*]
[*]The new editors can now filter content (tags, language, author).[/*]
[*]Lorebooks downloaded from the Steam Workshop now appear in the list of available lore books.[/*]
[*]Simplified the workflow to start playing (create / load a story)[/*]
[*]Created a server menu used to control it in real time.[/*]
[*]New menu to manage the Generators and Translators.[/*]
[*]Notifications are now displayed to give feed back to the user.[/*]
[*]Added a preview of the story reader style in the options.[/*]
[*]A brand-new edition menu (Named ‘Create’) to create / manage content.[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the scenario’s text not displaying after selecting a scenario from the workshop.[/*]
[*]Fixed crashes happening when naming files with special characters.[/*]
[*]Fixed contract with Satan.[/*]
[*]Fixed the escape menu not working when resizing the game.[/*]
[*]Fixed all the problems of interface related to resizing.[/*]
[*]Fixed custom fonts not working[/*]
[*]Fixed the lore book vanishing after editing the story (Oupsy. The shitty story editor has been deleted anyway).[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Under the hood[/h2]
[list]
[*]Rewrote the code managing your stories.[/*]
[*]Rewrote the code managing Scenarios.[/*]
[*]Rewrote the code managing Lore books.[/*]
[*]Rewrote the code managing settings.[/*]
[*]Debouched neighbour’s plumbing.[/*]
[*]Rewrote the code handling the translation.[/*]
[*]Rewrote the code managing saving[/*]
[*]Rewrote the code managing AIs[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Removed content (Temporally!)[/h2]
[list]
[*]No localization. I changed the system to manage the translations. So I need to transfer a lot of stuff.[/*]
[*]Connecting to a remote server isn’t working for now[/*]
[*]Removed the Console as it is not compatible with Godot 4 (and was pretty useless)[/*]
[/list]
[h2]To conclude[/h2]

I probably forgot stuff. I honestly don’t want to inspect the 500 changes one by one.

[b]Don't forget to write a review of the game to help me ;).[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/3e27414862896f98b7ab1dd6c979610d45c330b4.gif[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix of the open beta. 2.0.0.BETA.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I’m publishing a hotfix for the 2.0.0.BETA. It fixes a few urgent problems.
[h2]Important info about AIs[/h2]
The AIs are now stored in a new folder. Instead of being in the game’s folder, they will now be in the user’s data folder.

To move your AIs, open the old folder [i]path/to/game/models[/i] and move them to this folder:

Windows: %APPDATA%\aidventure\models
Linux: ~/.local/share/aidventure\models

Don’t forget to use the new hierarchy:

models/ 
-- translators/  
-- generators/  
-- customs/

[h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*]The text inside the input bar will now be wrapped (instead of having a horizontal scroll bar).[/*][*]Fixed the lorebook not being saved when editing it during a game.[/*][*]The text inside the notification won’t be clipped any more.[/*][*]Fixed the download error of AIs.[/*][*]Fixed the list of saves expending over its boundaries.[/*][*]Updated the server logs’ display to scroll down automatically as new text appears.[/*][*]Disabled the button “load translator” until you select a translator.[/*][*]Fixed duplication in the context leading to the AI repeating your inputs.[/*][*]Fixed the context and memory being repeated in the AI’s output when using the automatic translation[/*][/list][h2]What next?[/h2]
I have more stuff to fix and the localization to update. But you can expect the stable release for the 12th.

notes.title: Release 1.5.2 - Performances and Bugfixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Today I'm releasing a long awaited patch. It fixes bugs, expand the number of compatible graphical cards and [b]greatly improve the performances[/b].

With all these changes you will [b]have to redownload the AIs[/b]! You can delete the old ones.


 [h1]Changelog[/h1]

 [h2]Summary[/h2]

Here is a little summary of the improvements

- No more memory peak when the AI is loading.
- The possibility to specify how much memory you allow (on both CPU and GPU).
- The option to use a folder to write data instead of storing it in the memory (It's called offloading).
- Many new options for those who like to experiment.
- AI split into parts of 200 MB to allow a better memory management.

[h2]Client[/h2]

- Added 8 options. Here is a list of the most useful:
  - Offload model (Instead of running out of memory, the server will write on your disk)
  - limit_memory (Allows you to specify a maximum of memory for the server*)
    - gpu_max_memory (The maximum VRAM allowed)
    - cpu_max_memory (The maximum RAM allowed)
- All the files needed for a model are now saved in the same folder.
- Added `accessible_regular` font for better accessibility.
- Updated the credits.
- Fixed the server's logs never being displayed in the client.
- Fixed an error when loading scenarios from the Steam Workshop.
- Added the GPT4All-J model (Please, give me feedback about this model :))

* The limit of memory isn't perfect. It's a limit only for loading AIs. During the generation you will go above it.

 [h2]AIs[/h2]

- The AIs have all been modified (cut into small parts) to optimize their performances. You can learn more about how it works in this video

[previewyoutube=MWCSGj9jEAo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Server[/h2]

- Updated the dependencies (It makes compatible many graphical cards).
- The server is now capable to use both the CPU and GPU at the same time. Greatly improving the performances for users owning a compatible GPU.
- Updated the config file to give more control over the server when in self-hosting mod. 

You can find a full changelog of the server on GitHub https://github.com/LyaaaaaGames/AIdventure_Server/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0

notes.title: Pre release 1.5.2-BETA

Therefore, I believe it is safer to make it available only for volunteers for now.
[b]To use it, you will have to enable the "experimental" beta in the game's settings on Steam.[/b]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

- Updated the dependencies of the server. [url=https://github.com/LyaaaaaGames/AIdventure_Server/releases/tag/v1.2.2]Detailed changelog of the server, here[/url]
- Updated the installer to download the new dependencies.
- Updated the client to replace [url=https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main_classes/text_generation#transformers.GenerationConfig.max_length]max_length[/url] parameter by [url=https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main_classes/text_generation#transformers.GenerationConfig.max_new_tokens]max_token_length[/url] which is more efficient.
- Updated the Polish translation.

[h2]Nvidia 30k cards GPU problems[/h2]

This new version should fix the problem for the Nvidia 30xx cards not working.

notes.title: Community report of April 2023
notes.content:
Hi everyone. For this month I publish another small report !

[h3]Server's dependencies[/h3]

I updated the server and [url=https://github.com/LyaaaaaGames/AIdventure_Server/releases/tag/v1.2.2]published a new version[/url].
It will be shipped with the game in the next release.
The next release should come out by the end of the month or May. However, an experimental version (for those who can't wait)
should come out earlier!

I did some stats, and I'm happy to tell you the generation is now a bit faster. 
[b]It is ~10% faster[/b] (9.5% for generation with CPU and 12% for GPU generation).[i] Stats made with gpt2-large (for the CPU) and gpt2-medium (for the GPU)[/i]
The bigger the AI the more significant will be this improvement.

[h3]My current focus[/h3]

Because of my limited time, I will focus mainly on fixing bugs and improving the server.
About the server, I would like to implement the usage of both the CPU and GPU at the same time.
This would be great for users willing to run the big AIs.

[h3]A guide for players[/h3]

As I said in the last report, we now have a very good and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2936594086]complete guide on Steam[/url]
I recommend reading it. You will learn something (or many things) new!

Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Community Report of March 2023!
notes.content:
Hi everyone. This month it will be a very small report because not much happened!

As I said in the previous report. I have a full time job and little time to work on AIdventure.


[h3]The update of the server's dependencies[/h3]

The server runs on top of [url=https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/index]Transformers[/url].
The transformers' library had many updates and I plan to upgrade to a more recent version.

By updating I hope to improve the stability, the performances and fix the GPU not working for some cards.

A community member, [b]patman124[/b], created a very good and complete guide on Steam.
You can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2936594086]read it on Steam[/url]


That's all for this month!

notes.title: Community report of January 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/2a858ecd35c4b3612d3e0dd243da6b8b57292530.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone. I wish you happy new year. Today's come out the first report of 2023.

A few days ago I released the 1.5.0 which introduced the Steam Workshop. Now the next updates will be small patches to fix some problems.

[h3]The Korean translator[/h3]

In the 1.5.0 I tried a new type of AI to support the Korean. It was a failure and the Korean will be removed from the game until I have decent results. Sorry for the false hope.

The Turkish translator has the same problem, but I'm replacing it with another one which gave good results during my tests.

[h3]This year's plan[/h3]

I'm still employed full time. This mean I won't have much time to update the game. During December, I had a lot of free time and managed to work a lot on AIdventure but, it was an exception.

The next big update should be a full rework of the interface. The actual UI is... It is what it is. It will make the whole experience smoother for new players and nicer for users playing in full screen.

After the UI update, I should be working on the extension of the RPG system. This update should bring a lot of cool new features and bring AIdventure closer to its final state. However, because it will add new stuff it will also take more time! I can't give any release date.
